candidate.label: 0.7 Integration And Extension Hardening (repository source milestone)

decision.decidedBy: NF-118 technical assessment for the single maintainer
decision.rationale: All six 0.7 release-plan criteria are covered by source-bound policy and offline evidence. The implementation is ready for source-milestone review with explicit support and security limits; publication authority and exact-cut verification remain separate.

documentation.summary: The review maps all six release-plan criteria and reconciles current release, extension, validator, CLI and fixture-host notices.

schemas.summary: 18 schema files and all 17 kinds validate 109 maintained manifests. Registry and four profile schema checks passed.

examples.summary: Fictional registry, legacy migration and all four integration profiles have focused offline evidence.

validation.summary: 91 registry assertions, 108 integration cases, 17 compatibility cases and 51 installed CLI invocations retain unsupported and inert outcomes.

rfc-governance.summary: The existing single-maintainer process and accepted component boundary apply, with no personal review or independent sign-off claimed.

compatibility-migrations.summary: Exact version domains, source pins, preservation, legacy migration and known-history downgrade are explicit. CLI profile checks remain not-run.

security-limitations.summary: All five candidate dependency graphs have zero unresolved review inputs; existing scoped maintenance/tooling findings and source-distribution limits are retained.

release-evidence.summary: Prerequisite merges and all ten exact-source workflows passed. The previous source milestone is published; promotion and public-download checks follow a separate decision.

limitations: Source milestone with declarative profiles and offline fixtures; live integration, executable loading and hosted registry are unsupported.
The published CLI and validator preserve the existing preview versions and report extensionProfiles and runtime checks as not-run.
Compatibility reason labels belong to fixture evidence and have no public CLI or library API contract.
The source-only fixture host supports one synthetic operation, with in-memory receipts and no ExtensionSet admission.

The November 20 dependency evidence retains four root-maintenance and 19 npm-tool advisory instances under scoped dispositions; current-source CI and a future publication cut need their own dated assessment.
Ownership verification, publisher signatures, independent conformance and native/OS security certification are outside the qualified scope.
Publication and verification of future public 0.7 source archives are separate, pending actions.
